t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each colour of gnome is linked to a specific coloured basket. Learn which gnome is linked to each basket and go for the gnomes that give you the higher scoring basket. Once the mushrooms you get begin to go down swap to the other basket. The 5x multipliers are good for getting extra points.

vb_textbox.text: Each gnome is linked to either the red basket or the yellow basket. Learn which gnome is linked to which basket. Generally if a basket is giving you a high number of mushrooms it will continue to do so, but if the amount starts dropping you should try switching to the other basket. The 5x multiplier gives you more points but it's more important to consider how many mushrooms you're getting since that helps more with making decisions.
